units.contents:
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/curl --location --output /etc/yum.repos.d/tailscale.repo https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/fedora/tailscale.repo
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rpm-ostree install --allow-inactive --apply-live --assumeyes tailscale
ExecStart=/bin/touch /var/lib/%N.stamp
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl --no-block reboot
RemainAfterExit=yes
Type=oneshot

[Unit]
After=network-online.target
Before=zincati.service
ConditionPathExists=!/var/lib/%N.stamp
Description=rpm-ostree-install
Wants=network-online.target
units.name: rpm-ostree-install.service

units.contents:
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/mkdir --parents /var/lib/tailscale
ExecStart=/usr/bin/chmod 0700 /var/lib/tailscale
ExecStart=/usr/bin/chown --recursive 2000:2000 /var/lib/tailscale
ExecStart=/usr/bin/sleep 5
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/bash -c '/usr/bin/ethtool --features $(ip route get 1.1.1.1 | head --lines 1 | awk \'{print $5}\') rx-gro-list off rx-udp-gro-forwarding on'
RemainAfterExit=yes
Type=oneshot

[Unit]
After=network-online.target
Before=tailscaled.service
Description=tailscale-optimizations
Wants=network-online.target
units.name: tailscale-optimizations.service

units.contents:
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/tailscale
ExecStart=/usr/bin/tailscale up --advertise-exit-node --advertise-routes "${TS_ROUTES}" --auth-key "${TS_AUTH_KEY}"
ExecStop=/usr/bin/tailscale down
RemainAfterExit=yes
Type=oneshot

[Unit]
After=rpm-ostree-install.service
After=tailscaled.service
Description=tailscale
Wants=tailscaled.service
units.name: tailscale.service
